emotional_tone: Intimate, hand-crafted, storybook miniature, deeply romantic night atmosphere with warm glowing interiors against a moonlit indigo sky
design_archetype: Organic, Earthy & Storybook Miniature (Wood, Warm Amber Light, Night Forest, Hand-painted Signage)

typography.font_import_instructions: Import @fontsource-variable/dm-sans and @fontsource-variable/lora or @fontsource/poppins in frontend/src/index.css; include Google Font link or @fontsource for Caveat and Quicksand in index.html for the script storytelling beats.

typesetting_rules.story_beats: font-family: 'Caveat', cursive; font-size: 26px; line-height: 1.3; tracking: normal;
typesetting_rules.ui_body: font-family: 'Quicksand', 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; font-weight: 500;
typesetting_rules.signboard_text: font-family: 'Caveat', cursive; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #F3E9D2;
typesetting_rules.title_heading: font-family: 'Lora Variable', Georgia, serif; font-size: 32px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em;

entry_surfaces./: full-screen painterly night house scene with layered parallax, ambient animations, interactive front door, mailbox, easter eggs, and cinematic interior entry sequence

lighting_model.moonlight: Cool silvery-blue top-right diffuse wash (rgba(180, 205, 255, 0.12)) across roof ridges and foliage edges
lighting_model.window_glow: Warm amber (#FFB35C) radial gradient with slow breathing pulse (8s cycle, 0.75 to 0.95 opacity)
lighting_model.porch_lantern: Focal warm point (#FFA333) casting soft circular light onto porch steps and signboard with subtle rare 12-18s organic flicker
lighting_model.firefly_glow: Sharp chartreuse-yellow (#D9F27A) point lights with 3px Gaussian blur halo (filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px #D9F27A))
lighting_model.path_illumination: Faint amber glow bleeding from porch light onto stepping stones

texture_and_style.painterly_treatment: Use soft organic SVG vector paths with hand-drawn subtle irregularities (curved roofline, organic stone path, rounded window arches)
texture_and_style.wood_grain_accents: Rich timber brown (#3B2A20) planks on door and porch with darker grain shadows (#231812)
texture_and_style.smoke_particle_effect: Semi-transparent warm grey-cream puffs (#F3E9D2/35) drifting upward in wavy sinusoidal paths (8-12s cycle)
texture_and_style.curtain_sway: Delicate lace curtain silhouette in upper left window undulating softly (4-6s cycle)
texture_and_style.cat_silhouette: Cozy black cat silhouette (#15111F) perched in upper glowing window, tail swishing occasionally and stretching on click

layer_0_sky.description: Deep midnight backdrop (#12163B to #453B63) with crescent moon (clickable easter egg), drifting translucent clouds (60-120s loop), and 40+ twinkling stars with randomized CSS animation delays.

layer_1_distant_hills_trees.description: Dark silhouette of rolling forest ridge and pine trees (#201A2E) providing atmospheric depth.

layer_2_midground_house_and_garden.description: The centerpiece: asymmetrical two-story storybook house, timber porch, hanging lantern, glowing windows, stone chimney with smoke, carved signboard 'Aayushi & Me', curved flagstone pathway, cozy hedges, and mailbox.

layer_3_foreground_foliage_and_fireflies.description: Soft dark silhouette branches and tall grass at the viewport borders with 8-12 wandering glowing fireflies that react to cursor/touch.

layer_4_hud_and_story_overlay.description: Timed narrative hints ('There's something waiting inside…', 'Click the front door'), sound toggle button (Ambient/Lofi), easter egg counter badge (5 hidden moments), mailbox modal, and room preview drawer.

1_front_door_entry_sequence.trigger: Click or Enter key on front door
steps: 1. Camera smooth CSS zoom & pan toward front porch (scale: 1.55, translateY: 12%) over 1.6s
2. Porch light blooms warmer and brighter (intensity +60%)
3. Door handle turns down 25deg, door hinges open with transform: perspective(800px) rotateY(-78deg)
4. Radiant golden warm interior light blooms outwards from doorway (radial light shaft)
5. Cross-fade transition to interior placeholder sanctum with soft ambient chime
6. Display elegant Caveat handwritten typography: 'Welcome home. Our story lives inside every room.'
7. Provide button to 'Step Back Outside' or preview the 10 upcoming relationship rooms

2_mailbox_easter_egg.action: Mailbox lid opens with gentle creak; pops up a textured parchment note: 'Something special is being prepared… Happy Anniversary, Aayushi ❤️' with close button and cute wax seal animation.

3_cat_window_easter_egg.trigger: Click on cat silhouette in 2nd-floor glowing window
3_cat_window_easter_egg.action: Cat stands up, arches its back in a stretch, gives a tiny tail wiggle, and a soft purr sound cue/heart particle floats up.

4_chimney_puff_easter_egg.action: Spawns 3 rapid heart-shaped smoke puffs drifting into the night sky with a cozy crackle sound cue.

5_crescent_moon_easter_egg.action: Moon pulses with a gentle silver aura halo, spawning a shooting star that streaks across the upper night sky.

6_firefly_play_easter_egg.trigger: Click or hover over any wandering firefly
6_firefly_play_easter_egg.action: Firefly performs a swift spiral loop toward the house porch light before resuming peaceful wandering.

7_foliage_rustle_easter_egg.trigger: Click on garden hedges or trees
7_foliage_rustle_easter_egg.action: Leaves shake/rustle with a quick 3-degree oscillation and a tiny hidden firefly bursts out.

features: Web Audio API synthesized atmospheric soundscapes (no broken external audio links needed, with synthesized soothing night crickets + soft wind chime + warm vinyl crackle + acoustic guitar chords)
Mute/Unmute toggle button in top right HUD with visual sound wave animation
Audio manager interface: playAmbient(), playSFX(type), setRoomTrack(roomName)

motion_and_performance_spec.engine: CSS keyframe animations for all continuous ambient loops + requestAnimationFrame for mouse parallax + React state / Motion for interactive state transitions
motion_and_performance_spec.budget: Max 80 simultaneous animated nodes; hardware accelerated transforms (translate3d, scale, rotate)
motion_and_performance_spec.mobile_optimization: Device orientation gyroscope drift on mobile or gentle sinusoidal automatic idle breathing when touch is idle; touch-target sizes minimum 48x48px
motion_and_performance_spec.reduced_motion: Respects prefers-reduced-motion media query by disabling star twinkle loops, foliage sway, and parallax, while preserving immediate door opening on click

accessibility_requirements.keyboard_navigation: Tab navigation hits: 1. Audio Toggle, 2. Easter Egg Hints, 3. Signboard, 4. Mailbox, 5. Front Door, 6. Cat Window, 7. Chimney, 8. Moon
accessibility_requirements.focus_styling: Custom warm gold focus ring: outline: 2px solid #FFB35C; outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 6px;

aria_attributes.front_door: role='button' aria-label='Open front door to enter the house' tabindex='0'
aria_attributes.mailbox: role='button' aria-label='Open mailbox to read anniversary card' tabindex='0'
aria_attributes.easter_eggs: aria-label with descriptive text for screen readers

accessibility_requirements.touch_targets: All interactive elements have at least 48px touch bounding box

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete Stage 1 experience in frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx and supporting modular components (HouseScene.tsx, AudioPlayer.tsx, MailboxModal.tsx, InteriorView.tsx, RoomsPreviewModal.tsx, EasterEggTracker.tsx).

Ensure the SVG house is rich, custom-crafted, and painterly: multi-toned roof shingles, wood grain textures, warm glowing multi-pane windows with soft inner gradients, a glowing hanging lantern with a subtle flicker, chimney with drifting smoke puffs, and the carved signboard reading 'Aayushi & Me'.
Implement the full-screen parallax effect with layered depth (Sky -> Silhouette Mountains -> House & Path -> Foreground Fireflies).

Implement the custom loading sequence on first load: Pitch black -> single warm lantern ember appears -> ember grows into warm window light -> full night scene smoothly cross-fades in with gentle chime.
Implement the 5 interactive Easter eggs (Moon shooting star, Chimney extra heart smoke, Cat stretching with purr, Firefly spiral dance, Mailbox anniversary note).

Implement the cinematic Door Click sequence: smooth camera zoom, lantern bloom, door swings open in 3D perspective, golden light flood, cross-fade to intimate interior with handwritten 'Welcome home' narrative and rooms explorer.

Include a built-in Web Audio API synthesizer for romantic ambient night soundscapes (warm vinyl crackle, gentle acoustic guitar arpeggio, night crickets) so sound works instantly without any external audio asset dependencies.
Add all required data-testid attributes to all interactive elements for reliable end-to-end testing.
